provenance: Hand-written. recordedOutput values are stand-ins for model responses written by the framework author to exercise the deterministic pipeline; no model produced them.

requirement.title: Sign in to the storefront
requirement.description: Registered shoppers sign in with a username and password to reach the product catalogue. Locked accounts must not get in.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a valid standard account, when the shopper signs in, then the product list titled "Products" is shown.
Given a locked-out account, when the shopper signs in, then the error "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out." is shown and the shopper stays on the login page.
Given a wrong password, when the shopper signs in, then the error "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown.

requirement.source: examples/requirements (synthetic example for the saucedemo.com demo target)

scenarios.title: Standard user signs in and sees the product list
scenarios.objective: Verify a valid account reaches the catalogue
steps: Sign in as the standard user

scenarios.title: Locked-out user is refused
scenarios.objective: Verify locked accounts cannot sign in
steps: Sign in as the locked-out user
expectedOutcomes: Error "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out." is shown
Shopper stays on the login page

scenarios.title: Wrong password is rejected
scenarios.objective: Verify invalid credentials are refused
steps: Sign in with the standard username and a wrong password
expectedOutcomes: Error "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown

scenarios.title: Empty username shows a validation error
scenarios.objective: Check behaviour with no username
assumptions: The requirement does not say what happens with an empty username; assumed an error is shown
openQuestions: What message should an empty username produce?

ambiguities: "Locked accounts must not get in" does not say whether a locked user gets any guidance on unlocking.

requirement.title: Cart badge reflects cart contents
requirement.description: The cart icon shows how many items are in the cart.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Adding one product shows the badge with "1".
Removing the last product hides the badge.

scenarios.title: Badge shows 1 after adding one product
scenarios.objective: Badge shows 1 after adding one product

scenarios.title: Badge disappears when the last product is removed
scenarios.objective: Badge disappears when the last product is removed

requirement.title: Inventory requires sign-in
requirement.description: Only signed-in shoppers may see the inventory.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A signed-out visitor opening /inventory.html sees the error "Epic sadface: You can only access '/inventory.html' when you are logged in."

scenarios.title: Signed-out visitor cannot open the inventory
scenarios.objective: Signed-out visitor cannot open the inventory
